business_summary: Sunshine Global Circuits Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs) in China and internationally. The company offers AI acceleration card, heterogeneous computing server, optical module, server solid state drive, and high-voltage dc planar transformer; communication backplane, switch, active antenna, and communication power brick; as well as probe cards, load boards, vertical probe cards, and burn in boards. It also provides robot dog joint drive; axial-flux motor, dexterous hand joint motor, and robot joint motor; and ultra-thick copper power energy board, battery management system, charging station power distribution, and embedded busbar. The company exports its products to Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. Sunshine Global Circuits Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
